snippet.title: Vow of the Wordlocks Trailer
snippet.description:
Vow of the Wordlocks is a Roguelike where you cast spells with a Scrabble board-the higher the score, the stronger the sorcery. The player controls one of the witchers who swore a vow to become a Worldock, engaging enemies with bizzare fates and bosses with tragic histories. Randomly generated spellbooks invite to puzzle one's head over, while looting defeated enemies fuels the addictive hunt for the best possible items. 

wordlocks.com
